about_the_game:
Step into the ring with Ragdoll Boxing, a thrilling boxing experience built entirely on precise, real-time physics. Feel every punch, swing, and knockout as you control your boxer through active ragdoll mechanics, ensuring each fight feels uniquely dynamic and unpredictable.

Challenge friends in intense multiplayer battles, or test your skills against AI opponents that will push your boxing finesse to the limit. Train your technique and timing using customizable punching bags, refining the perfect rotation to amplify your strikes and maximize your damage output.

Whether you prefer keyboard and mouse precision or the intuitive feel of a controller, Ragdoll Boxing adapts seamlessly to your preferred play style. Master the physics-based combat system, delivering punches with careful rotations and strategic movements that determine the power behind every hit.

Experience spectacular knockouts powered by a sophisticated physics-driven system, making each KO uniquely satisfying. Ragdoll Boxing isn't just about fighting—it's about perfecting the sweet science of boxing through precise control and impeccable timing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio

short_description: Dive into Ragdoll Boxing, the ultimate physics-driven boxing game where every punch counts. Powered entirely by realistic, real-time physics, this game brings you closer to the raw excitement and unpredictability of a genuine boxing match. Control your boxer with intuitive active ragdoll mechanics.
